event: 2014 Preseason Game 3, Jacksonville at Detroit, August 22, 2014
frozen: 2014-08-21, after the reduction walkthrough and Stone's reduction; before any draw
provenance: Stone's written plan of August 15 to 22, 2014 (career/2014/04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Preseason_Games/Game_03/Preseason Game 3_ HC.md), applied August 15 to 21 and reduced under its own rules (career/2014/04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md#august-21-the-reduction-call-by-call). The vocabulary does not change from Chicago; the combinations do. Every call is a retained call from the active 2013 offensive book (Iteration I) that the 2014 program has taught; nothing was installed new for this game. The plan's opening 15 is carried in 'opener' in the plan's numbering, with calls 9 and 14 carried from their practiced pictures; the kernel labels snaps uniformly from the sheet and does not condition on script order, exit rules, conditions or alerts, which remain in-game coaching guidance.

menus.opening_15: Stone's order, opener 1 to 15: 12 Ace Power Right; 11 Trey Stick; 11 Doubles Drive HALF; 12 Wing Outside Zone Left; 12 Wing Boot Flood Right; 11 Bunch Mesh HALF; 11 Trips Inside Zone + Bubble; 12 Trey Y-Cross SOLID; 12 Ace Power Left (carried from 11 Doubles); 11 Trey Dagger HALF; 12 Wing Split Zone; 11 Doubles RB Slow Screen; 12 Ace Counter Right; 11 Doubles Spacing SCAT (carried from 11 Bunch); 12 Ace Power Pass MAX, conditional on the run picture. Situational football overrides it; no call exists merely because it is number 15
menus.third_down: third-and-short: Power, Counter, Inside Zone + Bubble (the access answer against a loaded box; Duo not active); third-and-medium: Mesh, Drive, Stick, Spacing; third-and-long: Dagger, Y-Cross, RB Slow Screen against justified pressure
menus.backed_up: Inside Zone, Power, Stick and the access throw if the leverage is free; the group on the field stays in
menus.red_zone: Power, Snag (low red zone only), Boot Flood; Mesh from Bunch carried from the spring red-zone work; Smash off, not taught in the 2014 program
menus.goal_line: Power, Counter, Power Pass only, the three run from that field location
menus.two_minute: Spacing (with and without the shift), Stick, Drive, Mesh, RB Slow Screen; the quarterback already on the field runs it
menus.four_minute: Inside Zone, Power, Counter and a safe complement from the normal-down sheet
menus.sudden_change: the next scheduled unit goes; the Outside Zone / Boot Flood pair from Wing, then the normal-down sheet
menus.HOLD_sequence: the primary Game 3 tempo concept: once a mixed eleven is on the field, keep it and change the formation. One sequence per group that rehearsed it (Cousins's groups, Henne's groups, the Wilson and Bray mixed groups), the five twelve-personnel pictures with no substitution: 12 Ace Power, 12 Trey Drive HALF, 12 Wing Split Zone, 12 SHIFT toward Empty Stick, back to 12 Ace
menus.PRESS_sequence: one sequence of mastered calls by signal and word: 11 Doubles Stick SCAT, 11 Doubles Spacing SCAT, 11 Doubles Inside Zone, 11 Bunch Mesh HALF; Cousins's young skill group if it reaches it and Henne's regular group; not Wilson, Bray or Shaw (a developmental quarterback earns PRESS in the preparation first, and the developmental groups did not run it this week)
menus.empty_rule: Empty is available only to the quarterback and personnel groups that rehearsed it this week: the shift to Empty from 11 personnel is on every group's sheet (Cousins's and Henne's groups carried it; Wilson's, Bray's and Shaw's groups rehearsed it August 19 and 20); the 12-personnel shift toward Empty only in the HOLD sequence for the groups that rehearsed it; the static 10-personnel Empty is off (not taught). The formation cannot appear because somebody sees it on another quarterback's wristband
menus.reduced_menu_bray_shaw: Power, Counter, Inside Zone, Stick, Spacing (with the shift), Mesh, Drive, Y-Cross, Boot Flood, RB Slow Screen, from the huddle; Bray's mixed possession runs the opening-15 calls his group rehearsed; Shaw's grade begins with protection identification, progression, timing and ball security, his movement an answer when the pocket breaks
menus.fourth_down: in the developmental portion, fourth-and-manageable across midfield is an evaluation opportunity, weighed on field position, quarterback, protection and situation; no automatic attempt (coaching guidance the kernel does not carry)

units_rule: A call with no 'units' field is available to every group that takes a possession; a 'units' field restricts it ('first' Cousins's groups, 'second' Henne's, 'third' Wilson's, 'fourth' Bray's, 'fifth' Shaw's). Protection defaults follow the book (quick game SCAT, five-man dropback HALF, heavy intermediate SOLID, boot NAKED, shot MAX) and are named only where Stone's plan names them or the default is recorded for audit.
notes: Johnson's workload (the reference possession, then Cousins's contingency possession if his operation is clean and no restriction is communicated) and Lucas's replacement possessions are carried in rotation.json; the clean-operation condition is coaching guidance the kernel's schema does not carry.

Script order, the return to the opener on the next appropriate normal down, the possession targets, the conditional shot and the plan's grading questions are coaching guidance the kernel does not condition on; they are recorded here and in rotation.json.

Off the sheet on August 21, each with its reason in the reduction table: 11 Doubles Power (carried as 12 Ace Power Left); 11 Bunch Spacing (carried as 11 Doubles Spacing SCAT); the 20-personnel and 10-personnel pictures; Texas; Duo; Four Verticals; Slant-Flat; Draw; the RB slip screen; Smoke; Smash; the ZIP motion. None has been taught in the 2014 program on the record; the active book holds every one of them.

Formation modifiers, direction and motion are descriptive fields; the kernel freezes them in the canonical sheet for audit and does not model motion response. Distinct directions of the same family from the same picture (Power Right and Left from Ace; Boot Flood Right and Left from Wing) are distinct calls on the plan and are frozen as such.
The plan's Trap, Wham, Jet, Scissors, flea flicker and 6OL exclusions are honoured by omission; the 6OL package has not been run in camp (Bradfield unsigned).

The defensive menu Crennel calls (Under and Nickel Even with their installed adjustments; Cover 1, 1 Robber/Rat, Cover 3, Quarters; base four and the installed five-man pressure; no rush games carried, none having been practiced in the 2014 program on the record) is sideline guidance recorded in rotation.json, not a kernel input.
